title: "Power Analysis Dashboard"
format: html

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
devtools::load_all("~/Documents/Research/Code/ECE")

make_params_label <- function(params_json) {
  params <- fromJSON(gsub('\\', '"', params_json, fixed = TRUE))
  if (length(params) == 0) return("")
  paste(names(params), unlist(params), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")
}

make_method_label <- function(method, method_params_json) {
  lab <- make_params_label(method_params_json)
  if (nzchar(lab)) paste0(method, " (", lab, ")") else method
}

make_scenario_label <- function(scenario, scenario_params_json) {
  lab <- make_params_label(scenario_params_json)
  if (nzchar(lab)) paste0("Scenario ", scenario, " (", lab, ")") else paste0("Scenario ", scenario)
}

results <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    method_label   = map2_chr(method,   method_params,   make_method_label),
    scenario_label = map2_chr(scenario, scenario_params, make_scenario_label)
  )

# cov_type is irrelevant (AR1 == compound), drop duplicates within scenario
type1_data <- results |>
  filter(metric == "power", r == 0) |>
  distinct(n, err_type, method_label, scenario_label, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(n = factor(n))

t1_data <- read_csv(
  here::here("data/results-t1.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    method_label   = map2_chr(method,   method_params,   make_method_label),
    scenario_label = map2_chr(scenario, scenario_params, make_scenario_label)
  )

# cov_type is irrelevant at r = 0; keep one row per (scenario, n, p, err_type, method)
t1_p2 <- t1_data |>
  filter(p == 2) |>
  distinct(scenario_label, n, err_type, method_label, .keep_all = TRUE)

t1_pp <- t1_data |>
  filter(p > 2) |>
  distinct(scenario_label, n, p, err_type, method_label, .keep_all = TRUE)

t1_scenarios <- sort(unique(t1_data$scenario_label))

local({
  z  <- qnorm(0.975)
  p0 <- 0.10
  ns <- unique(type1_data$n_sim)
  type1_null_lo <<- (p0 + z^2/(2*ns) - z*sqrt(p0*(1-p0)/ns + z^2/(4*ns^2))) / (1 + z^2/ns)
  type1_null_hi <<- (p0 + z^2/(2*ns) + z*sqrt(p0*(1-p0)/ns + z^2/(4*ns^2))) / (1 + z^2/ns)
})

power_data <- results |>
  filter(metric == "power")

power_p2 <- power_data |> filter(p == 2, amp == 1)
power_pp  <- power_data |> filter(p >  2, amp == 1)

n_choices       <- sort(unique(power_data$n))
all_methods     <- sort(unique(results$method))
default_methods <- c("z.test.oracle", "z.test.null.oracle")
scenarios       <- sort(unique(power_p2$scenario_label))

two_legend_plotly <- function(pl) {
  method_idx <- which(vapply(pl$x$data, function(t) nzchar(t$name), logical(1)))
  half <- ceiling(length(method_idx) / 2)
  for (i in seq_along(method_idx)) {
    pl$x$data[[method_idx[i]]]$legend <- if (i <= half) "legend" else "legend2"
  }
  pl$x$layout$legend <- list(
    title = list(text = ""), orientation = "h",
    x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = -0.2
  )
  pl$x$layout$legend2 <- list(
    orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "left", y = -0.2
  )
  pl
}

plot_type1 <- function(data) {
  p <- data |>
    mutate(err_type = fct_relevel(err_type, "normal")) |>
    arrange(method_label, err_type) |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x     = n,
      y     = metric_val,
      color = method_label,
      shape = err_type,
      text  = paste0(
        scenario_label, "<br>",
        method_label, "<br>",
        err_type, "<br>",
        "rejection rate: ", metric_val
      )
    )) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10,          linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = type1_null_lo, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = type1_null_hi, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(normal = 16, exponential = 17), guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(vars(scenario_label)) +
    labs(y = "Rejection Rate", x = "Sample Size", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()

  two_legend_plotly(ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text"))
}

plot_power_diff <- function(data, ref_method, by_p = FALSE) {
  ref <- data |>
    filter(method == ref_method) |>
    select(r, err_type, cov_type, p, ref_val = metric_val)

  diff_data <- data |>
    filter(method != ref_method) |>
    left_join(ref, by = c("r", "err_type", "cov_type", "p")) |>
    mutate(diff_val = ref_val - metric_val)

  p <- diff_data |>
    arrange(method_label, err_type, r) |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x        = r,
      y        = diff_val,
      color    = method_label,
      group    = interaction(method_label, err_type),
      linetype = err_type,
      shape    = err_type,
      text     = paste0(
        scenario_label, "<br>",
        method_label, "<br>",
        err_type, "<br>",
        "r = ", r, "<br>",
        "Δ power: ", round(diff_val, 3)
      )
    )) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(normal = "solid", exponential = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(normal = 16, exponential = 17), guide = "none") +
    { if (by_p)
        facet_grid(rows = vars(cov_type), cols = vars(p), labeller = label_both)
      else
        facet_wrap(vars(cov_type), labeller = label_both) } +
    labs(y = paste0("Δ Power (", ref_method, " − method)"),
         x = "Correlation (r)", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()

  two_legend_plotly(ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text"))
}

plot_power <- function(data, by_p = FALSE) {
  p <- data |>
    arrange(method_label, err_type, r) |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x        = r,
      y        = metric_val,
      color    = method_label,
      group    = interaction(method_label, err_type),
      linetype = err_type,
      shape    = err_type,
      text     = paste0(
        scenario_label, "<br>",
        method_label, "<br>",
        err_type, "<br>",
        "r = ", r, "<br>",
        "power: ", metric_val
      )
    )) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(normal = "solid", exponential = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(normal = 16, exponential = 17), guide = "none") +
    { if (by_p)
        facet_grid(rows = vars(cov_type), cols = vars(p), labeller = label_both)
      else
        facet_wrap(vars(cov_type), labeller = label_both) } +
    labs(y = "Power", x = "Correlation (r)", color = "Method") +
    theme_bw()

  two_legend_plotly(ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text"))
}
```

```{r}
selectInput(
  "n_sel", "Sample Size (n):",
  choices  = n_choices,
  selected = n_choices[1]
)
checkboxGroupInput(
  "err_types", "Error Type:",
  choices  = c("normal", "exponential"),
  selected = "normal",
  inline   = TRUE
)
checkboxGroupInput(
  "methods", "Methods:",
  choices  = all_methods,
  selected = default_methods,
  inline   = TRUE
)
```

## P-curve

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (sc in t1_scenarios) {
  cat("##", sc, "\n\n")
  if (any(t1_p2$scenario_label == sc)) {
    cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pcurve_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  if (any(t1_pp$scenario_label == sc)) {
    cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pcurvep_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
cat(":::\n")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
lapply(t1_scenarios, function(sc) {
  local({
    s <- sc
    if (any(t1_p2$scenario_label == s)) {
      output[[paste0("pcurve_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
        n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
        d <- t1_p2 |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val,
                              err_type %in% input$err_types,
                              method %in% input$methods)
        ggplotly(plot_pvals(d, color_by = "method_label", facet = ~err_type))
      })
    }
    if (any(t1_pp$scenario_label == s)) {
      output[[paste0("pcurvep_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
        n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
        d <- t1_pp |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val,
                              err_type %in% input$err_types,
                              method %in% input$methods)
        ggplotly(plot_pvals(d, color_by = "method_label", facet = facet_grid(vars(err_type), vars(p))))
      })
    }
  })
})
```

## Power

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (sc in scenarios) {
  cat("##", sc, "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pw_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == sc)) {
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("pwp_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
  local({
    s <- sc
    output[[paste0("pw_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
      n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
      plot_power(power_p2 |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val, err_type %in% input$err_types, method %in% input$methods))
    })
    if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == s)) {
      output[[paste0("pwp_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
        n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
        plot_power(power_pp |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val, err_type %in% input$err_types, method %in% input$methods), by_p = TRUE)
      })
    }
  })
})
```

## Comparison

```{r}
selectInput(
  "ref_method", "Reference Method:",
  choices  = all_methods,
  selected = all_methods[1]
)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (sc in scenarios) {
  cat("##", sc, "\n\n")
  cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("cmp_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == sc)) {
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(as.character(plotlyOutput(paste0("cmpp_", make.names(sc)), height = "100vh")))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
lapply(scenarios, function(sc) {
  local({
    s <- sc
    output[[paste0("cmp_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
      n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
      ref   <- input$ref_method
      d <- power_p2 |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val,
                               err_type %in% input$err_types,
                               method %in% c(input$methods, ref))
      plot_power_diff(d, ref_method = ref)
    })
    if (any(power_pp$scenario_label == s)) {
      output[[paste0("cmpp_", make.names(s))]] <- renderPlotly({
        n_val <- as.integer(input$n_sel)
        ref   <- input$ref_method
        d <- power_pp |> filter(scenario_label == s, n == n_val,
                                 err_type %in% input$err_types,
                                 method %in% c(input$methods, ref))
        plot_power_diff(d, ref_method = ref, by_p = TRUE)
      })
    }
  })
})
```
